title: 第3章 原来你一直在隐藏修为第4章 以一敌十修为再次提升
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
“云儿！”
“大少爷！”
见到楚云出现，楚啸天露出欣喜之色。
楚家族人也是一脸激动。
此刻他们似乎已经忘记，楚云是一个不能修炼的废物。
不过仅仅只是片刻时间，他们就反应了过来。
“不对，少爷不是不能修炼吗？怎么会变得这么强大？”
“是啊，难道少爷一直在隐藏修为？”
这一刻，不仅是楚家族人吃惊，就连李青山和王云峰也是满脸惊愕。
“你不是不能修武吗？”
“地武境，怎么可能？”
两人看着楚云就像看怪物一样。
地武境跟玄武境不同，地武境出手时会带动大地之力。
刚才楚云出手，很明显释放的就是大地之力。
楚云目光扫视众人，面对众人的疑惑，他没有解释，而是缓缓转身，朝着李青山和王云峰走去。
他每走一步，两人都会胆寒一分。
他们只有玄武境，面对地武境强者根本没有还手之力。
“原来你一直在隐藏修为，但是我想不明白，你的修为为何如此高？”
就连太玄宗宗主修炼数百年，也才修炼到地武境。
可楚云才十几岁，就已经是地武境修为，他想不清楚，想不明白对方是怎么做到的。

楚云没有回答他，而是缓缓抬起手臂。
只见在他手掌心里面，出现一个黑色漩涡。
漩涡出现后，李青山便感觉一股吸力将自己笼罩，体内的玄力正不受控制地往外流逝。
“我从来不会向一个死人解释。”
冰冷的声音吐出。
啊！
随着这道声音响起，李青山仰头发出一声撕心裂肺的惨叫。
只见他的身体以肉眼可见的速度，被楚云吸成一具干尸。
“魔……魔功，你跟天魔教是什么关系？”
王云峰看到这一幕，直接被吓破了胆。
天魔教是青州第一邪派，这个门派修炼各种诡异的魔功，所以他认为楚云修炼的功法，跟天魔教有关系。
楚云没有回答他，而是再次抬起手臂。
王云峰见状，直接吓得跪在地上。
“楚云，不……不要杀我，你还记得吗？小时候我还抱过你。”
楚云脸上没有半点表情，道：“走吧，我不杀你。”
content_en:
"Yun'er!"
"Young Master!"
Seeing Chu Yun appear, Chu Xiaotian showed joy.
The Chu family members also looked excited.
At this moment, they seemed to have forgotten that Chu Yun was a waste who could not cultivate.
But it only took a moment for them to react.
"No, isn't the young master unable to practice? How could he become so powerful?"
"Yes, has the young master been hiding his cultivation?"
At this moment, not only the Chu family members were surprised, but also Li Qingshan and Wang Yunfeng were shocked.
"Can't you practice martial arts?"
"How is this possible in the Earth Martial Realm?"
The two looked at Chu Yun like a monster.
The Earth Martial Realm is different from the Xuanwu Realm. The Earth Martial Realm will bring about the power of the earth when taking action.
When Chu Yun took action just now, it was obvious that what he released was the power of the earth.
Chu Yun glanced at everyone. Faced with everyone's doubts, he did not explain, but slowly turned around and walked towards Li Qingshan and Wang Yunfeng.
Every step he takes makes both of them feel a little more frightened.
They only have the Xuanwu Realm, and they have no power to fight back against the strong ones in the Earth Martial Realm.
"It turns out that you have been hiding your cultivation, but I don't understand why your cultivation is so high?"
Even the head of Taixuan Sect had only reached the Earth Martial Realm after practicing for hundreds of years.
But Chu Yun was only a teenager and already at the Earth Martial Realm. He couldn't think clearly and couldn't understand how the other party did it.
Chu Yun did not answer him, but slowly raised his arm.
A black vortex appeared in the palm of his hand.
After the vortex appeared, Li Qingshan felt a suction force envelope him, and the profound energy in his body was flowing out uncontrollably.
"I would never explain that to a dead man."
A cold voice spat out.
ah!
As this voice sounded, Li Qingshan raised his head and let out a heart-rending scream.
His body was sucked into a mummy by Chu Yun at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Mo... Mo Gong, what is your relationship with the Demon Sect?"
Wang Yunfeng was frightened when he saw this scene.
The Heavenly Demon Sect is the number one evil sect in Qingzhou. This sect practices various weird demonic skills, so he believes that the skills Chu Yun practices are related to the Heavenly Demon Sect.
Chu Yun did not answer him, but raised his arm again.
When Wang Yunfeng saw this, he was so frightened that he knelt on the ground.
"Chu Yun, no...don't kill me, do you remember? I hugged you when you were a child."
Chu Yun had no expression on his face and said, "Let's go, I won't kill you."
